conclusion: Partial support: MISEV2023 supports the requirement for orthogonal characterization, appropriate controls, and validated intact-EV assays prior to advancing formulations (supports claim-ev-cmc-requirements). The remaining program-specific assertions about absence of MCB/WCB, scalable reproducible production, and lack of cross-species intranasal translatability are unsupported because the cited evidence (MISEV2023) is guidance only and does not include program-specific manufacturing or biodistribution data.
unsupported_assertions: claim-source-cell-scalability: The assertion that current program materials do not demonstrate characterized source-cell MCB/WCB or scalable, reproducible production sufficient to support advancing a specific intranasal formulation is unsupported by the cited evidence (MISEV2023) because that guidance does not contain program-specific manufacturing records or batch data.

claim-rodent-cns-delivery: The assertion that rodent intranasal biodistribution findings will not translate to larger species (or that lot-to-lot reproducibility across species is lacking) is unsupported by the cited evidence (MISEV2023); MISEV provides best-practice recommendations but does not supply program- or literature-level cross-species biodistribution or intact-EV recovery data to evaluate translatability.
